headline: Rodri linked with Madrid; Liverpool said to be open on Van Dijk
paragraphs: Real Madrid's reported interest in Rodri is the most-carried story in today's feed: BBC ran it across two of its own outlets, and Sky's Manchester City desk has a separate item saying Madrid are working on a deal. All are gossip-desk reports rather than anything official, and the BBC pair share a newsroom, so treat the volume as attention rather than independent confirmation.

Elsewhere, BBC's column has Liverpool open to offers for Virgil van Dijk, and says wage demands have put Salah's move to Saudi Arabia in doubt — both single-sourced. Sky carries two pieces on Maresca settling in at Manchester City after replacing Guardiola. Nothing in today's feed is a completed transfer.
